- SOC2: Redwood provides a Type II report covering the inference control plane and infra; we can confirm the latest report date and the sampled assertion periods. If you need a tailored assertion mapping, Laura can provide the mapping doc.

Mina / team — draft language for the MSA exhibit: 

"Inspection Rights. Customer may, at its sole cost and subject to prior written notice of not less than thirty (30) days, conduct a bounded inspection of Redwood’s systems solely to the extent necessary to verify Redwood’s compliance with the security commitments set forth in the Security Exhibit. All inspections will be conducted during mutually agreed windows and limited to sampling of evidence related to the applicable SOC 2 controls. Inspection access is limited to authorized representatives and shall be performed in a manner that does not materially disrupt Redwood’s operations. Redwood will provide reasonable evidence exports and audit logs for the agreed sampling window; Redwood retains audit logs for ninety (90) days from the timestamp of the event.

Penetration Testing. Customer-initiated penetration testing requires written notice no less than fourteen (14) calendar days prior to the proposed window. Tests will be limited to the agreed scope and, where applicable, to a dedicated staging environment or ephemeral access provisioned by Redwood. Any access provided will be logged, and a post-test handback package (findings + relevant telemetry) will be delivered within ten (10) business days following test completion, subject to Redwood’s standard responsible disclosure procedures."

I’ve attached the short doc (msa_redline_snippet.docx) — Connor, if you can confirm technical feasibility for ephemeral jumpbox sessions + session logs that would be great.

Ben Carter
Senior Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference

Elena — thanks all for the quick back-and-forth. Summary and Mutual Action Plan (MAP) ahead of Monday’s call (11:00am PT): 

1) SOC2 evidence: Laura will attach the assertion mapping and latest Type II report during the call. Action: Laura -> deliver mapping by Monday 10:30am PT.
2) Evidence retention: Redwood confirms audit logs retained 90 days; exports for agreed sample windows will be produced as CSV + limited query extracts. Action: Mina/Connor -> prepare export runbook and example payload by Monday EOD.
3) Pen test cadence & access: Acceptable options: (A) isolated staging environment provided to Acme with test account(s) and session logging, or (B) ephemeral jumpbox access with pre-authorized IPs and session capture. Notice: 14 calendar days. Post-test deliverable: findings + telemetry within 10 business days. Action: Connor -> checklist for provisioning and session logging feasibility.
4) MSA language: Ben’s draft is our preferred starting point (bounded inspection + sampling). If Acme is ok with that wording we’ll insert it into the MSA exhibit and mark for final legal review. Action: Ben -> produce tracked redline after Monday call.

Proposed MSA insertion (short): 

"Bounded inspection and sampling. Notwithstanding any other provision, inspection rights are limited to non-disruptive, time-boxed sampling targeted at SOC 2 controls listed in the Security Exhibit and subject to thirty (30) days’ prior written notice, except that penetration tests require fourteen (14) days’ notice. Redwood will provide reasonable evidence exports for the agreed sampling window; log retention is ninety (90) days. Inspections must be carried out by authorized personnel under nondisclosure obligations and must be coordinated with Redwood’s Security team to avoid operational impact"

If that reads ok to Acme we can get Ben’s tracked redline in HubSpot and the DocuSign packet ready for signature. Adding the calendar invite now.
